mappings.coverage: whole bounded arena initializer or prefix hash
mappings.qualification: Valid disjoint cursor variable, aligned table destination and readable name storage. Offsets represent original pointers portably; native uint32 alignment/wrap arithmetic is preserved but invalid wrapped process addresses are excluded. Persistent signed initialization flag gates on any nonzero value. Repeated calls retain existing table/cursor; explicit external resets to0 cause another aligned1024-byte allocation. ASCII names only because original signed-byte high-bit indexing can read before the hash table. Prefix length is unsigned32-bit and stops at firstNUL. Allocator ownership and sound database/bucket population remain outside this two-helper scope. Managed replay pending.
